plugins.name: explain-diff
plugins.description: Explain a git branch or pull request diff as a self-contained prose HTML document, with inline-SVG diagrams and a test-case table.

plugins.name: comment-gc
plugins.description: Collect the comment garbage that piles up during agentic coding: delete stale, historical, and self-evident comments, compress verbose ones to their point, keep the load-bearing why - while changing zero lines of code, proven mechanically by a bundled guard script.

plugins.name: usage-hud
plugins.description: A one-line HUD above the prompt with the context-window bar, session cost, 5h and weekly rate-limit usage, and a live prompt-cache countdown that turns cold when the cache TTL lapses. A function-hooks mod.
